doc: Game layer for the experiment library. State is ONE list: the ids of completed experiments. Everything else (rings, unlocked experiments, bonus stages) is derived by progression/unlock.mjs. Sensitive experiments (care.sensitive) are never required by any rule.

rule_dsl.sourceCompleted: { "sourceCompleted": "person" } -- any experiment of that source type

rings.name: Spark
rings.promise: One tap, one minute. Hear what a feeling sounds like.

rings.name: Echo
rings.promise: Your first sound opens the doors: places, people, seasons.

rings.name: Chorus
rings.promise: Blend two things you love into one sound.

rings.name: Harmony
rings.promise: Words for love from other languages; harmony from other traditions.

rings.name: Constellation
rings.promise: The deep experiments: two cultures, two films, your whole story in chords.

bonus_stages.name: Make it yours
bonus_stages.what: Sliders to nudge the feeling before it becomes chords.

bonus_stages.name: Was, is, will be
bonus_stages.what: Hear the same feeling as a memory, as now, or as a hope (LOVE-VOCAB tense modifier).

bonus_stages.name: The answer
bonus_stages.what: Your sound is framed by the love call D and its answer G -- re-love.

design_notes: Minimal: no points, no streaks, no timers, no loss. Progress only ever opens things; nothing is taken away.
Every ring is reachable without completing any sensitive experiment (tests/unlock.test.mjs enforces it).
A ring's promise is the only copy the visitor sees about the game; the studio shows the next locked ring's promise as a gentle 'next'.
Sequels (rule completed: X) make it feel like a path: the quick film theme opens the two-film blend, etc.
